summary.description: Vinyl chloride is a flammable gas with a faint sweet smell used mainly in the production of PVC plastics.
environmental_impact: Can cause cancer and damage to multiple human organ systems at high exposure levels
Reacts in the atmosphere to form harmful ground-level ozone
Can leach into groundwater due to its mobility in soil and water

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Vinyl chloride is a known carcinogen and causes damage to multiple organ systems with high exposure, representing a direct risk to human health.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: The widespread industrial use and hazardous byproducts of vinyl chloride highlight the need for safer, more sustainable production practices.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Due to its mobility in soil and water, vinyl chloride can contaminate groundwater, posing a threat to safe water supplies.
